column1: # Words of the northern group. Columns: kind (unit, spatial or legal), word (upper case, no accents, periods dropped).

# unit: follows a house number and belongs to it: lgh (PostNord Sweden, apartment), st, kl, th, tv, mf (Danmarks Adresser, floor and side), dz and korp (Latvian rules for unified postal addresses, apartment and building), Ullakkohuoneisto (UPU Finland example, attic flat).
# spatial: a line that starts so is not a street line: Bolignummer and Bnr (Posten Norge, the dwelling number line above the street).
# legal: a legal-form word that ends a company name: ApS, A/S, I/S, K/S, IVS, P/S (Denmark), AB, HB, KB (Sweden), Oy, Oyj, Ky (Finland), AS, ASA, ANS (Norway), ehf, hf, slf (Iceland).
